name: mohammad-travels
description: Muhammad Tours and Travels — B2B/B2C/Corporate travel platform monorepo

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@mohammad-travels/types && npm run build --workspace=apps/api && npm run build --workspace=apps/web && npm run build --workspace=apps/b2b && npm run build --workspace=apps/corporate && npm run build --workspace=apps/admin
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:types && npm run typecheck --workspace=apps/api && npm run typecheck --workspace=apps/web && npm run typecheck --workspace=apps/b2b && npm run typecheck --workspace=apps/corporate && npm run typecheck --workspace=apps/admin && npm run typecheck --workspace=apps/mobile
scripts.db:seed: npm run build --workspace=@mohammad-travels/types && ts-node database/seeds/seed.ts && npm run db:seed:reference-data && npm run db:seed:suppliers
scripts.deploy:migrate: docker compose --env-file .env.production -f docker-compose.production.yml run --rm api npx prisma migrate deploy
scripts.deploy:seed: docker compose --env-file .env.production -f docker-compose.production.yml run --rm api npx ts-node database/seeds/seed.ts && docker compose --env-file .env.production -f docker-compose.production.yml run --rm api npx ts-node database/seeds/reference-data.seed.ts && docker compose --env-file .env.production -f docker-compose.production.yml run --rm api npx ts-node database/seeds/suppliers.seed.ts
scripts.deploy:seed:demo: docker compose --env-file .env.production -f docker-compose.production.yml run --rm api npx ts-node database/seeds/demo-accounts.seed.ts
